faq_q1: How can I get my business to stand out on Google Maps and in local search?
faq_a1: Standing out on Google Maps requires three things: an optimized Google Business Profile, consistent reviews, and strong local SEO on your website. Kliendid Kodulehele connects these parts into one system so your business appears to people already searching for your service in your area. Our work includes profile optimization, service-specific landing pages, local keywords, technical SEO, and inquiry-focused content. The goal is more purchase-ready inquiries, not just more traffic.
faq_q2: Can Kliendid Kodulehele get my business into the top 3 on Google Maps?
faq_a2: Yes — our goal is to get your business into the top 3 on Google Maps through local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and a conversion-focused web strategy. We don't sell empty clicks or pretty reports. In our Standard and Quarterly packages we work in a 90-day growth sprint. If agreed visibility and inquiry growth don't move in the right direction, we continue working for free until the goal is reached.
faq_q3: Why doesn't my beautiful website generate inquiries?
faq_a3: A beautiful website won't generate inquiries if it doesn't answer buyer questions, isn't visible on Google, or doesn't clearly guide visitors to the next step. In that case, the site is more of a digital business card than a sales channel. Kliendid Kodulehele builds websites focused on visibility, trust, and conversion. That means a clear offer, fast loading, strong messaging, SEO structure, social proof, and forms or automations that help turn visitors into inquiries.
faq_q4: How do I turn my website into a 24/7 sales machine?
faq_a4: A website becomes a sales machine when it does three things well: attracts the right visitor, removes purchase hesitation, and makes sending an inquiry easy. That requires SEO, a strong offer, clear CTA buttons, trust-building proof, and automation. Kliendid Kodulehele helps build a system where your website does more than display information. It captures inquiries, qualifies leads, routes them into your CRM, and helps accelerate the sales process even outside business hours.
faq_q5: How can I get more purchase-ready clients without burning money on Google or Meta ads?
faq_a5: The best way to reduce dependence on ad spend is to build an organic visibility system. SEO, local search, content marketing, and Google Maps optimization help you reach people who are already searching for your product or service. Paid ads can deliver fast results, but traffic often disappears when the budget stops. Organic SEO works differently: every well-optimized page, article, and service page can generate inquiries for months or years. Kliendid Kodulehele focuses on building this kind of long-term digital asset.
faq_q6: What's the difference between a regular website and a conversion-optimized website?
faq_a6: A regular website shows who you are. A conversion-optimized website shows customers why they should contact you specifically. The difference is in messaging, structure, speed, trust signals, and sales psychology. A conversion-optimized website has a clear value proposition, strong CTAs, visible proof, a simple inquiry form, fast loading, and a logical path from visitor to customer. Kliendid Kodulehele builds websites for exactly this outcome: more inquiries, not just prettier design.
faq_q7: How do AI and automation help grow sales?
faq_a7: AI and automation help grow sales by responding to prospects faster, reducing manual work, and keeping leads warm until they are ready to buy. For example, an AI chatbot can answer recurring questions, collect contact details, qualify inquiries, and send information directly to your CRM. Kliendid Kodulehele uses AI-assisted content strategies, conversational solutions, and automations to reduce friction in the sales process. The goal is simple: no good inquiry should be lost just because the response came too late.
faq_q8: How can I automate sales processes with AI?
faq_a8: Sales automation starts with mapping repetitive tasks. Usually, you can automate inquiry capture, initial replies, lead qualification, follow-up emails, bookings, and CRM entry. Kliendid Kodulehele helps build a system where your website, AI chatbot, forms, and CRM work together. This delivers better-prepared inquiries to your sales team and saves time on tasks that don't need to be done manually.

faq_a12: Webflow makes it possible to build fast, visually strong, and easy-to-manage websites without excessive plugins or technical clutter. It's a great fit for companies that want a modern site, good performance, and simple integrations with CRM and sales tools. Kliendid Kodulehele uses Webflow to build websites that are fast, secure, SEO-friendly, and conversion-optimized. Less technical noise means more focus on what matters: inquiries and sales.
faq_q13: Which website mistakes cause Estonian companies to lose the most inquiries?
faq_a13: The most common mistakes are an unclear offer, slow page speed, weak CTA, missing social proof, overly complex contact forms, and no SEO structure. If a visitor can't understand what you offer and why to trust you within a few seconds, they leave for a competitor. Kliendid Kodulehele fixes these issues systematically. We evaluate websites not only through design, but through sales, SEO, user experience, and data.
faq_q14: How do I measure whether my website and SEO are actually generating revenue?
faq_a14: Website profitability should be measured through inquiries, booked calls, sales opportunities, and real revenue. Clicks, impressions, and traffic matter only if they ultimately help increase sales. Kliendid Kodulehele focuses on business-outcome metrics: Google visibility, Google Maps rankings, organic inquiries, form submissions, leads that reach the CRM, and conversion rate. Good marketing should not end with a report, but with a new customer.
faq_q15: How is Kliendid Kodulehele different from a typical digital marketing agency?
faq_a15: Kliendid Kodulehele is different from a typical agency because our focus isn't only on design, clicks, or content production — it's on a system that combines your website, SEO, Google Maps, AI automation, and CRM into one sales channel. We don't just build a pretty website. We build a digital system that helps your business become more visible, more trusted, and easier to buy from. The goal is more high-quality inquiries and better return from every visitor.
faq_q16: What is conversion optimization and how does it increase sales?
faq_a16: Conversion rate optimization (CRO) is the process of turning more website visitors into paying customers — without increasing ad spend. It involves analyzing where visitors drop off, why they don't contact you, and making targeted improvements to messaging, structure, loading speed, and CTAs. Even a 1% improvement in conversion rate can significantly increase revenue. Kliendid Kodulehele measures the impact of every change using data.
faq_q17: How do I commission an e-commerce website that actually sells?
faq_a17: An e-commerce site that actually sells starts with three foundations: fast loading speed, a simple user experience, and a clear purchase journey. Without these, even the most beautiful online shop is a cost center, not a sales channel. Kliendid Kodulehele develops e-commerce websites optimized for SEO, mobile-friendly, fast, and connected to sales and automation systems. We shift the focus from design to revenue.
faq_q18: What should a good marketing agency actually do?
faq_a18: A good marketing agency measures results by inquiries and sales, not just clicks and impressions. It connects your website, SEO, content strategy, and automation into one customer acquisition system — not siloed channels. Kliendid Kodulehele works exactly this way: we aim for business outcomes, not activity lists. A good agency takes risks alongside you — as our guaranteed results model reflects.
faq_q19: How can I quickly increase my website's conversion rate?
faq_a19: You can quickly improve website conversion rate with five changes: a clearer headline that states exactly what you offer; a stronger CTA button; more visible social proof; a simpler contact form; and faster loading speed. These don't require a full redesign but can multiply conversions. Kliendid Kodulehele first assesses which change will have the greatest impact, then implements it within the first 30 days.
